hook: Nigeria just signed a crypto executive order

stories.text: Nigeria signs executive order to regulate virtual assets
stories.summary: Nigeria's President Bola Tinubu signed an executive order that creates a Virtual Asset Council and a regulatory sandbox for cryptocurrencies.

stories.text: Ransom note demands millions in bitcoin in Guthrie case
stories.summary: A newly revealed ransom note in the Nancy Guthrie case demanded millions of dollars in bitcoin, according to a crime podcast.

stories.text: India finance panel backs SROs for crypto regulation
stories.summary: India's Parliamentary Committee on Finance recommended a framework using Self-Regulatory Organizations for crypto oversight.

stories.text: EU bars Belarusians from owning MiCA crypto firms
stories.summary: The European Union expanded sanctions to prevent Belarusian nationals from controlling MiCA-regulated crypto firms after August 25.

stories.text: CLARITY Act regains momentum with ethics compromise
stories.summary: The CLARITY Act, a key US crypto bill, gained new momentum after an ethics compromise revived its regulatory outlook.
